name: summarize
description: Summarize a single hash-bound source section. Read-only; the caller must already hold the expected content hash from the upstream DocReadV1 reference.
authorityNotes: Uses only membrane_source_read, which performs a hash-bound DocReadV1 section fetch. No persistence or escalation.

arguments.name: sourceRef
arguments.description: DocReadV1 source reference (path:startLine-endLine) for the section to summarize.

arguments.name: anchorId
arguments.description: Anchor identifier within the DocReadV1 reference.

arguments.name: expectedContentHash
arguments.description: sha256 digest the caller already holds for the section; the operation fails closed on mismatch.

content.text: Summarize the section referenced by ${sourceRef} (anchor=${anchorId}) in repository=${repository}. Call membrane_source_read with sourceRef="${sourceRef}", anchorId="${anchorId}", expectedContentHash="${expectedContentHash}". Report the section's contentSha256 verbatim and a concise summary. If the read fails on source_read_hash_mismatch or source_read_anchor_missing, surface the typed error and stop — never paraphrase around it.
